+// Image selection caps: max 2 landscape, 1 portrait (fixed requirement)
+export function canAdd(selected: { portrait: boolean }[], next: { portrait: boolean }): boolean {
+  const matchingSelections = selected.filter(selection => selection.portrait === next.portrait).length;
+  return matchingSelections < (next.portrait ? 1 : 2);
+}
